Integração e a coerência da estratégia de conteúdo audiovisual, com time de marketing.  Operar equipamentos audiovisuais, incluindo câmeras DSLR, iluminação e captação de áudio e compor cenografia. Capacidade de trabalhar em equipe, colaborar efetivamente e gerenciar múltiplos projetos simultaneamente.  Vontade de se desenvolver na função de Videomaker.  Interesse em criação de roteiros e em tratamento de áudio. title: Consultora de vendas - campinas
description:
Empresa está contratando Consultora de vendas - campinas em campinas. Veja detalhes e envie seu currículo.

A consultora de vendas de vestidos de noiva de alto padrão atua como uma especialista na criação de uma experiência personalizada e sofisticada para as noivas, auxiliando-as na escolha de vestidos exclusivos e de luxo para o casamento. Sua função vai além da venda tradicional, exigindo profundo conhecimento de moda, habilidades de atendimento personalizado e sensibilidade para entender as necessidades emocionais e estilísticas das clientes. Abaixo estão as principais responsabilidades dessa função.     Este papel exige sensibilidade, tato, conhecimento técnico e um atendimento impecável, pois a consultora de vendas é responsável por tornar a escolha do vestido de noiva um momento único e especial, digno da importância que essa peça tem no grande dia.     Atendimento Personalizado  Recepção da Cliente: Receber as noivas com cordialidade e profissionalismo, criando um ambiente acolhedor e de confiança desde o primeiro contato.  Entendimento das Preferências: Realizar entrevistas detalhadas para compreender o estilo, preferências pessoais, tipo de casamento e orçamento da noiva.  Apresentação dos Vestidos: Sugerir opções de vestidos de noiva de acordo com o perfil da cliente, explicando detalhes sobre os designers, tecidos, cortes e acabamentos.     Consultoria de Moda e Estilo  Análise do Estilo da Noiva: Ajudar a noiva a identificar o estilo que mais valoriza sua personalidade e tipo de corpo, oferecendo orientações sobre tendências, caimentos e o que combina com o evento planejado.  Sugestão de Acessórios: Recomendar complementos como véus, grinaldas, joias e sapatos, harmonizando o look completo para o dia do casamento.  Provadores e Provas: Acompanhar as provas dos vestidos, fazendo sugestões de ajustes e personalizações que garantam o caimento perfeito.     Conhecimento de Produto  Domínio de Coleções: Manter-se atualizada sobre as últimas coleções de vestidos de noiva, incluindo designers de renome, tecidos exclusivos e detalhes de acabamento.  Explicação Técnica: Orientar as clientes sobre a qualidade dos materiais, tipos de bordados, rendas, pedrarias e outras características que diferenciam os vestidos de alto padrão.  Novas Tendências: Ficar por dentro das tendências internacionais de moda noiva e novidades do mercado de luxo.     Gerenciamento de Vendas  Fechamento da Venda: Conduzir o processo de venda desde a apresentação até o fechamento, utilizando habilidades de negociação e empatia para garantir a satisfação da cliente.  Gestão de Encomendas: Fazer o acompanhamento dos pedidos, verificando prazos de produção e entrega dos vestidos, e mantendo a cliente informada sobre o status do seu pedido.  Follow-up Pós-venda: Manter contato com as clientes após a compra, assegurando que os ajustes e personalizações sejam realizados conforme o esperado e garantindo que a noiva esteja satisfeita com o resultado final.     Relacionamento com a Cliente  Construção de Relacionamentos: Criar e manter um relacionamento próximo com as clientes, proporcionando um atendimento exclusivo e personalizado.  Resolução de Dúvidas: Estar disponível para responder dúvidas e lidar com eventuais preocupações das noivas durante o processo de escolha e compra.  Fidelização: Garantir que a experiência da noiva seja memorável, incentivando a fidelidade e as recomendações para futuras noivas.     Administração e Organização  Gestão de Agenda: Organizar e agendar atendimentos e provas, garantindo que cada cliente tenha tempo suficiente para escolher e experimentar os vestidos com calma e atenção.  Organização da Loja: Assegurar que o ambiente de venda esteja impecável, com os vestidos devidamente apresentados e expostos de forma a atrair e encantar as clientes.  Controle de Estoque: Auxiliar na gestão do estoque de vestidos e acessórios, garantindo que a loja tenha uma variedade de peças adequadas para diferentes perfis de clientes.     Acompanhamento de Mercado e Concorrência  Análise de Concorrência: Monitorar o mercado de luxo e as ações de concorrentes, entendendo como os outros fornecedores de vestidos de noiva de alto padrão estão se posicionando.  Sugestão de Melhorias: Propor melhorias no processo de vendas, atendimento e escolha de coleções com base no feedback das clientes e tendências do mercado.

title: Site Reliability Engineering Manager
description:

About the Team  SRE Middleware & Data (SRE M&D) enables product teams by providing secure, scalable, and automated data, middleware, and AI services on Azure.   Provisioning: Automates secure delivery of databases, queues, caches, and AI services/resources; builds self-service and guardrails.   Reliability: Ensures availability, performance, and resilience of data, middleware, and AI services in production; builds observability, autohealing, and disaster recovery.   What You Will Do   Lead and grow the team: Manage, mentor, and develop SRE engineers across Provisioning and Reliability.    Lead cross-team initiatives:    Align roadmaps with Architects and partner teams; ensure adoption of architecture standards.    Run design reviews and architecture signoffs; surface and mitigate risks and complexity early.    Translate standards into guardrails and automation (policyascode, selfservice) for consistent delivery.    Apply lightweight RACI and clear escalation paths to resolve tradeoffs quickly.    Drive roadmap and execution:   Provisioning: Self-service engines, Crossplane/Terraform-based automation, policy-as-code, secured pipelines, access management, backups/restore, Azure AI resource provisioning, and quota management.    Reliability: Observability integrations (New Relic, Azure Monitor), performance tuning, autohealing, DR/BCP, resilience testing, failover automation, SLOs, reliability for Azure AI services and messaging platforms (Kafka, Event Hubs, Service Bus).    Establish engineering excellence:   Infrastructure as Code (Terraform/Crossplane) and CI/CD best practices.    Change management with safe deploys and rollback strategies.    Incident and problem management with blameless postmortems.    Continuous improvement loops measured by DORA/SRE metrics.    Champion security and compliance by design:    Policy as code, least privilege access, and secrets/identity hygiene.    Guardrails in self-service flows; auditability and evidence collection.    Partnership with Security/Compliance for standards and reviews.    Partner with the Architects:   Codevelop platform architecture and service standards.    Define SLIs/SLOs and capacity/reliability patterns for core services.    Align roadmaps and run design reviews for high-impact changes.    Own delivery outcomes:   Navigate competing priorities across a broad platform scope — balancing reactive operational load (incidents, toil, on-call) against proactive platform investment (self-service, automation, resilience) without a clean separation between the two.    Make and communicate prioritization decisions under ambiguity, with partial information, across teams that have conflicting urgency.    Maintain a defensible, visible backlog that reflects real risk and business impact — not just the loudest stakeholder.    Operate a healthy on-call:   High-quality playbooks and automation-first troubleshooting (AI-assisted).    Actionable alerts with SLO-based paging and noise reduction.    Regular resilience testing and post-incident hardening.    Initiatives You Will Lead:   Self-service provisioning for databases, queues, and caches with golden configurations and policy guardrails.    AI-assisted troubleshooting for provisioning and production incidents.    Platform wide observability integration for data, middleware, and AI services (New Relic, Azure Monitor).    Automated DR runbooks and resilience/chaos testing in production.    Performance tuning at service and query layers, including automated tuning workflows.    Standardization of provisioning via Terraform/Crossplane for databases, messaging, and AI services.    Governance for Azure AI services (quotas, access, safety guardrails) with clear consumption patterns for product teams.    Success Metrics   Reduced MTTR and incident count, improved SLO attainment for data/middleware services.    Improved lead time for change and change failure rate; increased automation coverage and reduced toil.    Faster time to provision and higher first success rate for self-service requests.    Measurable improvements in cost efficiency, performance, and capacity predictability.    Team health: engagement, growth, hiring velocity, stress levels, and retention.    SLO attainment for AI endpoints and messaging services; reduced alert noise via improved observability (New Relic/Azure Monitor).    What You Will Bring   Proven experience managing SRE/platform/infrastructure teams delivering production-critical services.    Deep familiarity with Azure and the team stack: PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Cosmos DB; Redis; messaging systems such as CloudAMQP/RabbitMQ, Kafka, Event Hubs, and Service Bus.    Strong reliability fundamentals: SLOs/SLIs, incident and problem management, capacity, DR/BCP, performance tuning.    Solid automation background: IaC (Terraform/Crossplane), CI/CD (Azure DevOps), GitOps, policyascode, secrets and identity, RBAC.    Track record of building selfservice platforms and reducing toil.    Excellent crossfunctional leadership with product, security, and compliance partners.    Experience operating Azure AI services in production (Azure OpenAI, Cognitive Services, AI Search).    Observability experience with New Relic, Azure Monitor, and OpenTelemetry.    What You'll Need   Advanced skills in English    Experience with AI-assisted operations and troubleshooting.    Observability expertise (Prometheus/Grafana, New Relic, Azure Monitor, OpenTelemetry).    Database performance engineering and query optimization.    Experience in regulated environments and security frameworks.    FinOps capabilities (cost governance, forecasting, rightsizing, quotas, budgets, chargeback/showback).    How We Work   Collaboration first with a strong partnership between the Engineering Manager and the Architects.    Automation by default; security and reliability are nonnegotiable.    Blameless postmortems, continuous learning, and measurable outcomes.    Participation in an equitable on-call rotation with high-quality runbooks and automation.    Tech Environment   Azure (AKS, managed databases, storage, networking, identity).   Azure AI services (Azure OpenAI, Cognitive Services, AI Search).   Azure DevOps for CI/CD.   CloudAMQP (RabbitMQ).   Databases: PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Cosmos DB.   Caches: Redis.   Queues/Brokers: Kafka, Event Hubs, Service Bus.   Terraform/Crossplane, GitOps.   Observability: New Relic, Azure Monitor, logs, metrics, traces, alerting workflows.

title: Site Reliability Engineering Manager
description:
Confira a oportunidade para Site Reliability Engineering Manager em campinas. Veja requisitos e como se candidatar.

About the Team   SRE Middleware & Data (SRE M&D) enables product teams by providing secure, scalable, and automated data, middleware, and AI services on Azure.  Provisioning: Automates secure delivery of databases, queues, caches, and AI services/resources; builds self-service and guardrails.  Reliability: Ensures availability, performance, and resilience of data, middleware, and AI services in production; builds observability, autohealing, and disaster recovery.  What You Will Do   Lead and grow the team: Manage, mentor, and develop SRE engineers across Provisioning and Reliability.   Lead cross-team initiatives:   Align roadmaps with Architects and partner teams; ensure adoption of architecture standards.   Run design reviews and architecture signoffs; surface and mitigate risks and complexity early.   Translate standards into guardrails and automation (policyascode, selfservice) for consistent delivery.   Apply lightweight RACI and clear escalation paths to resolve tradeoffs quickly.   Drive roadmap and execution:  Provisioning: Self-service engines, Crossplane/Terraform-based automation, policy-as-code, secured pipelines, access management, backups/restore, Azure AI resource provisioning, and quota management.   Reliability: Observability integrations (New Relic, Azure Monitor), performance tuning, autohealing, DR/BCP, resilience testing, failover automation, SLOs, reliability for Azure AI services and messaging platforms (Kafka, Event Hubs, Service Bus).   Establish engineering excellence:   Infrastructure as Code (Terraform/Crossplane) and CI/CD best practices.   Change management with safe deploys and rollback strategies.   Incident and problem management with blameless postmortems.   Continuous improvement loops measured by DORA/SRE metrics.   Champion security and compliance by design:   Policy as code, least privilege access, and secrets/identity hygiene.   Guardrails in self-service flows; auditability and evidence collection.   Partnership with Security/Compliance for standards and reviews.   Partner with the Architects:  Codevelop platform architecture and service standards.   Define SLIs/SLOs and capacity/reliability patterns for core services.   Align roadmaps and run design reviews for high-impact changes.   Own delivery outcomes:  Navigate competing priorities across a broad platform scope — balancing reactive operational load (incidents, toil, on-call) against proactive platform investment (self-service, automation, resilience) without a clean separation between the two.   Make and communicate prioritization decisions under ambiguity, with partial information, across teams that have conflicting urgency.   Maintain a defensible, visible backlog that reflects real risk and business impact — not just the loudest stakeholder.   Operate a healthy on-call:  High-quality playbooks and automation-first troubleshooting (AI-assisted).   Actionable alerts with SLO-based paging and noise reduction.   Regular resilience testing and post-incident hardening.   Initiatives You Will Lead:   Self-service provisioning for databases, queues, and caches with golden configurations and policy guardrails.   AI-assisted troubleshooting for provisioning and production incidents.   Platform wide observability integration for data, middleware, and AI services (New Relic, Azure Monitor).   Automated DR runbooks and resilience/chaos testing in production.   Performance tuning at service and query layers, including automated tuning workflows.   Standardization of provisioning via Terraform/Crossplane for databases, messaging, and AI services.   Governance for Azure AI services (quotas, access, safety guardrails) with clear consumption patterns for product teams.   Success Metrics   Reduced MTTR and incident count, improved SLO attainment for data/middleware services.   Improved lead time for change and change failure rate; increased automation coverage and reduced toil.   Faster time to provision and higher first success rate for self-service requests.   Measurable improvements in cost efficiency, performance, and capacity predictability.   Team health: engagement, growth, hiring velocity, stress levels, and retention.   SLO attainment for AI endpoints and messaging services; reduced alert noise via improved observability (New Relic/Azure Monitor).   What You Will Bring   Proven experience managing SRE/platform/infrastructure teams delivering production-critical services.   Deep familiarity with Azure and the team stack: PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Cosmos DB; Redis; messaging systems such as CloudAMQP/RabbitMQ, Kafka, Event Hubs, and Service Bus.   Strong reliability fundamentals: SLOs/SLIs, incident and problem management, capacity, DR/BCP, performance tuning.   Solid automation background: IaC (Terraform/Crossplane), CI/CD (Azure DevOps), GitOps, policyascode, secrets and identity, RBAC.   Track record of building selfservice platforms and reducing toil.   Excellent crossfunctional leadership with product, security, and compliance partners.   Experience operating Azure AI services in production (Azure OpenAI, Cognitive Services, AI Search).   Observability experience with New Relic, Azure Monitor, and OpenTelemetry.   What You’ll Need   Advanced skills in English   Experience with AI-assisted operations and troubleshooting.   Observability expertise (Prometheus/Grafana, New Relic, Azure Monitor, OpenTelemetry).   Database performance engineering and query optimization.   Experience in regulated environments and security frameworks.   FinOps capabilities (cost governance, forecasting, rightsizing, quotas, budgets, chargeback/showback).   How We Work   Collaboration first with a strong partnership between the Engineering Manager and the Architects.   Automation by default; security and reliability are nonnegotiable.   Blameless postmortems, continuous learning, and measurable outcomes.   Participation in an equitable on-call rotation with high-quality runbooks and automation.   Tech Environment   Azure (AKS, managed databases, storage, networking, identity).  Azure AI services (Azure OpenAI, Cognitive Services, AI Search).  Azure DevOps for CI/CD.  CloudAMQP (RabbitMQ).  Databases: PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Cosmos DB.  Caches: Redis.  Queues/Brokers: Kafka, Event Hubs, Service Bus.  Terraform/Crossplane, GitOps.  Observability: New Relic, Azure Monitor, logs, metrics, traces, alerting workflows.

Especialistas de Negócio: Stakeholders com profundo conhecimento de mercado, com os quais você trocará experiências diariamente para desenhar a melhor solução. Seus Desafios e Responsabilidades:  1. Concepção e Estratégia (Foco em Resultado)  Mentalidade de Construção: Liderar a descoberta de produtos, realizando benchmarking e pesquisas para identificar oportunidades reais, seja em novos mercados ou na otimização interna. Decisão Baseada em Fatos: Eliminar o "achismo". Utilizar dados e evidências para validar se estamos resolvendo o problema certo antes de iniciar o desenvolvimento. Entrega Incremental (MVP): Definir a primeira versão do produto com assertividade. O objetivo não é criar softwares complexos que demoram meses para sair do papel, mas entregar valor rápido e iterar com base no uso real. 2. Engenharia de Processos e Lógica  Mapeamento de Cenários (As Is / To Be): Mergulhar na operação para entender o cenário atual e projetar o processo futuro otimizado. O software deve ser o reflexo de um processo inteligente. Raciocínio Lógico: Mapear fluxos condicionais e regras de decisão (ex: "Se Cliente A, então Ação B"), traduzindo a complexidade do negócio em diagramas visuais que tragam clareza absoluta para o time técnico. 3. Especificação Técnica e PRD (Product Requirements Document)  Documentação Precisa: Criar PRDs que funcionem como a "fonte da verdade", contendo fluxogramas, regras de negócio e critérios de aceite detalhados para eliminar dúvidas durante o desenvolvimento. Wireframing e Prototipação Básica: Para demandas de menor complexidade ou validações rápidas de fluxo, você deve ter autonomia para desenhar wireframes ou mockups funcionais. Lógica de Dados: Estruturar logicamente quais dados, filtros e critérios são necessários para a construção de relatórios e telas, facilitando o trabalho da engenharia. Requisitos (O que buscamos em você)  Histórico comprovado na construção e lançamento de produtos ou funcionalidades relevantes. Raciocínio Lógico Estruturado: Facilidade para quebrar problemas grandes em etapas menores, sequenciais e lógicas. Habilidade com Fluxogramas: Experiência em desenhar processos de forma visual (BPMN ou fluxos livres). Escrita Técnica de Excelência: Capacidade de detalhar requisitos cobrindo cenários de sucesso, erro e exceção com clareza impecável. Autonomia em Prototipação: Conforto em rabiscar interfaces funcionais para tangibilizar ideias. Comunicação Articulada: Habilidade de transitar entre o time técnico e os especialistas de negócio com fluidez, garantindo alinhamento total. Diferencial Competitivo  IA como Copiloto: Buscamos profissionais que já incorporaram a Inteligência Artificial no seu fluxo de trabalho diário. Valorizamos quem sabe utilizar a IA como um parceiro intelectual e alavanca de produtividade — seja para estruturar cenários, refinar documentações, gerar insights de dados ou acelerar o dia a dia. title: Site reliability engineering manager
description:

About the Team SRE Middleware & Data (SRE M&D) enables product teams by providing secure, scalable, and automated data, middleware, and AI services on Azure. Provisioning: Automates secure delivery of databases, queues, caches, and AI services/resources; builds self-service andguardrails. Reliability: Ensures availability, performance, and resilience of data, middleware, and AI services in production; builds observability, autohealing, and disaster recovery. What You Will Do Lead and grow the team: Manage, mentor, and develop SRE engineers across Provisioning and Reliability. Lead cross-team initiatives: Align roadmaps with Architects and partner teams; ensure adoption of architecture standards. Run design reviews and architecture signoffs; surface and mitigate risks and complexity early. Translate standards into guardrails and automation (policyascode, selfservice) for consistent delivery. Apply lightweight RACI and clear escalation paths to resolve tradeoffs quickly. Drive roadmap and execution: Provisioning: Self-service engines, Crossplane/Terraform-based automation, policy-as-code, secured pipelines, access management, backups/restore, Azure AI resource provisioning, and quota management. Reliability: Observability integrations (New Relic, Azure Monitor), performance tuning, autohealing, DR/BCP, resilience testing, failover automation, SLOs, reliability for Azure AI services and messaging platforms (Kafka, Event Hubs, Service Bus). Establish engineering excellence: Infrastructure as Code (Terraform/Crossplane) and CI/CD best practices. Change management with safe deploys and rollback strategies. Incident and problem management with blameless postmortems. Continuous improvement loops measured by DORA/SRE metrics. Champion security and compliance by design: Policy as code, least privilege access, and secrets/identity hygiene. Guardrails in self-service flows; auditability and evidence collection. Partnership with Security/Compliance for standards and reviews. Partner with the Architects: Codevelop platform architecture and service standards. Define SLIs/SLOs and capacity/reliability patterns for core services. Align roadmaps and run design reviews for high-impact changes. Own delivery outcomes: Navigate competing priorities across a broad platform scope — balancing reactive operational load (incidents, toil, on-call) against proactive platform investment (self-service, automation, resilience) without a clean separation between the two. Make and communicate prioritization decisions under ambiguity, with partial information, across teams that have conflicting urgency. Maintain a defensible, visible backlog that reflects real risk and business impact — not just the loudest stakeholder. Operate a healthy on-call: High-quality playbooks and automation-first troubleshooting (AI-assisted). Actionable alerts with SLO-based paging and noise reduction. Regular resilience testing and post-incident hardening. Initiatives You Will Lead: Self-service provisioning for databases, queues, and caches with golden configurations and policy guardrails. AI-assisted troubleshooting for provisioning and production incidents. Platform wide observability integration for data, middleware, and AI services (New Relic, Azure Monitor). Automated DR runbooks and resilience/chaos testing in production. Performance tuning at service and query layers, including automated tuning workflows. Standardization of provisioning via Terraform/Crossplane for databases, messaging, and AI services. Governance for Azure AI services (quotas, access, safety guardrails) with clear consumption patterns for product teams. Success Metrics Reduced MTTR and incident count, improved SLO attainment for data/middleware services. Improved lead time for change and change failure rate; increased automation coverage and reduced toil. Faster time to provision and higher first success rate for self-service requests. Measurable improvements in cost efficiency, performance, and capacity predictability. Team health: engagement, growth, hiring velocity, stress levels, and retention. SLO attainment for AI endpoints and messaging services; reduced alert noise viaimproved observability (New Relic/Azure Monitor). What You Will Bring Proven experience managing SRE/platform/infrastructure teams delivering production-critical services. Deep familiarity with Azure and the team stack: Postgre SQL, Mongo DB, Cosmos DB; Redis; messaging systems such as Cloud AMQP/Rabbit MQ, Kafka, Event Hubs, and Service Bus. Strong reliability fundamentals: SLOs/SLIs, incident and problem management, capacity, DR/BCP, performance tuning. Solid automation background: Ia C (Terraform/Crossplane), CI/CD (Azure Dev Ops), Git Ops, policyascode, secrets and identity, RBAC. Track record of building selfservice platforms and reducing toil. Excellent crossfunctional leadership with product, security, and compliance partners. Experience operating Azure AI services in production (Azure Open AI, Cognitive Services, AI Search). Observability experience with New Relic, Azure Monitor, and Open Telemetry. What You’ll Need Advanced skills in English Experience with AI-assisted operations and troubleshooting. Observability expertise (Prometheus/Grafana, New Relic, Azure Monitor, Open Telemetry). Database performance engineering and query optimization. Experience in regulated environments and security frameworks. Fin Ops capabilities (cost governance, forecasting, rightsizing, quotas, budgets, chargeback/showback). How We Work Collaboration first with a strong partnership between the Engineering Manager and the Architects. Automation by default; security and reliability are nonnegotiable. Blameless postmortems, continuous learning, and measurable outcomes. Participation in an equitable on-call rotation with high-quality runbooks and automation. Tech Environment Azure (AKS, managed databases, storage, networking, identity). Azure AI services (Azure Open AI, Cognitive Services, AI Search). Azure Dev Ops for CI/CD. Cloud AMQP (Rabbit MQ). Databases: Postgre SQL, Mongo DB, Cosmos DB. Caches: Redis. Queues/Brokers: Kafka, Event Hubs, Service Bus. Terraform/Crossplane, Git Ops. Observability: New Relic, Azure Monitor, logs, metrics, traces, alerting workflows.

title: Product owner
description:

Olá, futuro(a) PO (Product Owner PL/SR) ! ✨ Estamos em busca de um Product Owner versátil, capaz de atuar em duas frentes estratégicas: tirar novas ideias do papel (Zero to One) e liderar a transformação digital de processos existentes, convertendo operações manuais ou complexas em experiências digitais fluidas. Mais do que organizar tarefas, você será o responsável por estruturar a solução. Seja concebendo um produto inédito ou modernizando um fluxo operacional, sua missão é garantir que cada decisão técnica e de negócio tenha um propósito claro. Você atuará na intersecção entre estratégia, processos e tecnologia, impulsionando a entrega de valor real. Onde você vai jogar (Time e Estrutura): Você fará parte de uma estrutura robusta e colaborativa. Não atuará isolado(a), mas sim como peça central de uma célula multidisciplinar composta por: Time de UX/Design: Para garantir fluidez e usabilidade. Squad de Desenvolvimento & QA: Engenheiros focados em performance e qualidade. Especialistas de Negócio: Stakeholders com profundo conhecimento de mercado, com os quais você trocará experiências diariamente para desenhar a melhor solução. Seus Desafios e Responsabilidades: 1. Concepção e Estratégia (Foco em Resultado) Mentalidade de Construção: Liderar a descoberta de produtos, realizando benchmarking e pesquisas para identificar oportunidades reais, seja em novos mercados ou na otimização interna. Decisão Baseada em Fatos: Eliminar o "achismo". Utilizar dados e evidências para validar se estamos resolvendo o problema certo antes de iniciar o desenvolvimento. Entrega Incremental (MVP): Definir a primeira versão do produto com assertividade. O objetivo não é criar softwares complexos que demoram meses para sair do papel, mas entregar valor rápido e iterar com base no uso real. 2. Engenharia de Processos e Lógica Mapeamento de Cenários (As Is / To Be): Mergulhar na operação para entender o cenário atual e projetar o processo futuro otimizado. O software deve ser o reflexo de um processo inteligente. Raciocínio Lógico: Mapear fluxos condicionais e regras de decisão (ex: "Se Cliente A, então Ação B"), traduzindo a complexidade do negócio em diagramas visuais que tragam clareza absoluta para o time técnico. 3. Especificação Técnica e PRD (Product Requirements Document) Documentação Precisa: Criar PRDs que funcionem como a "fonte da verdade", contendo fluxogramas, regras de negócio e critérios de aceite detalhados para eliminar dúvidas durante o desenvolvimento. Wireframing e Prototipação Básica: Para demandas de menor complexidade ou validações rápidas de fluxo, você deve ter autonomia para desenhar wireframes ou mockups funcionais. Lógica de Dados: Estruturar logicamente quais dados, filtros e critérios são necessários para a construção de relatórios e telas, facilitando o trabalho da engenharia. Requisitos (O que buscamos em você) Histórico comprovado na construção e lançamento de produtos ou funcionalidades relevantes. title: Analista data viz sr.
description:
Confira a oportunidade para Analista data viz sr. em campinas. Veja requisitos e como se candidatar.

Esse(a) profissional será responsável por transformar dados em narrativas visuais claras, eficientes e orientadas ao negócio, indo além da construção de dashboards e garantindo que toda a jornada dos dados — desde as camadas analíticas até a visualização — seja confiável, performática e escalável. O desafio envolve atuar com grandes volumes de dados em ambientes cloud, estruturando e preparando dados nas camadas analíticas (especialmente Silver e Gold), organizando métricas e regras de negócio, e construindo visualizações que realmente gerem valor para as áreas. Buscamos alguém com forte pensamento analítico, domínio dos fundamentos de visualização de dados e experiência prática na preparação e modelagem de dados para consumo em BI. Mais do que dominar ferramentas específicas, esperamos alguém que entenda profundamente como dados se transformam em informação e decisão. Como Analista de Data Visualization Sênior, você atuará em conjunto com times multidisciplinares, sendo a ponte entre dados e negócio, garantindo que as soluções analíticas sejam compreensíveis, confiáveis e acionáveis. Se você gosta de contar histórias com dados, estruturar informações de forma inteligente e atuar próximo ao negócio para gerar impacto real, essa oportunidade é para você. Responsabilidades e atribuições Desenvolver dashboards e produtos de dados focados em geração de insights e suporte à tomada de decisão. Traduzir necessidades de negócio em soluções visuais claras, intuitivas e eficientes. Atuar na preparação e transformação de dados nas camadas analíticas (Silver e Gold), garantindo qualidade e consistência. Modelar dados para consumo em ferramentas de BI, aplicando boas práticas de performance e escalabilidade. Definir e organizar métricas e KPIs em conjunto com as áreas de negócio, promovendo padronização. Aplicar princípios de Data Visualization (design, storytelling, hierarquia de informação, UX analítica). Otimizar dashboards e queries visando melhor performance e experiência do usuário. Garantir a qualidade dos dados utilizados nas visualizações por meio de validações e consistência lógica. Trabalhar em parceria com Analytics Engineers, Data Engineers e áreas de negócio. Documentar dashboards, métricas e regras de negócio de forma clara e acessível. Apoiar na definição de boas práticas de visualização, modelagem e consumo de dados. Contribuir para a evolução da cultura data-driven na organização. Requisitos e qualificações Experiência sólida com Data Visualization, BI ou Analytics. Domínio dos fundamentos de visualização de dados (storytelling, design, percepção visual, UX). Experiência com ferramentas de BI como Power BI, Tableau e Looker. Conhecimento em modelagem de dados para consumo analítico. Domínio em SQL para exploração, transformação e validação de dados. Experiência com preparação de dados (ETL/ELT), especialmente em camadas analíticas (Silver e Gold). Conhecimento em linguagens das ferramentas de BI, como DAX e Linguagem M (Power BI). Familiaridade com ambientes de dados em cloud e conceitos de Data Lake, Data Warehouse ou Lakehouse. Capacidade de entender regras de negócio e traduzi-las em métricas e visualizações. Experiência com otimização de queries e performance de dashboards. Boa comunicação para interação com stakeholders técnicos e não técnicos. Vivência com metodologias ágeis (Scrum, Kanban). Requisitos desejáveis Experiência com Python aplicado a análise e visualização de dados. Conhecimento em frameworks de visualização interativa como Streamlit. Experiência com construção de produtos de dados além de dashboards (apps analíticos, data products). Vivência com grandes volumes de dados e ambientes distribuídos. Conhecimento em versionamento de código e boas práticas de desenvolvimento. Experiência com testes e validação de dados. Remuneração CLT compatível com o mercado; 100% remoto; Flash - Cartão de Benefícios Flexíveis com todas as categorias habilitadas: Alimentação, Refeição, Mobilidade, Educação, Saúde e Cultura; Seguro de Vida; Plano de Saúde (Porto Seguro); Plano Odontológico (Porto Seguro); PLR de acordo com a política da empresa; Voucher Smash Card no dia do aniversário; Parceria com escola de inglês; Programa de indicação #amigosv8.tech; Total Pass; Guapeco (benefício pet); Alura (plataforma de cursos online); Certificações de parceiros; Convênio SESC.

description:

About Us PI Ag Sciences is the global agriculture business of PI Industries, a US$ 1 billion revenue company with a legacy of over 80 years driving innovation across the agri value chain. We are ranked among the top 5 global players in custom synthesis and manufacturing (CSM) of agrochemicals, with operations in more than 40 countries, 4,000+ employees, and a world-class R& D ecosystem of over 700 scientists. In Brazil, we are growing fast and are today a global strategic hub for the company, backed by consistent investments in people, infrastructure, and new business. The opportunity We are looking for a professional to act as a strategic and operational partner in managing our facilities, support services, and the overall employee and leadership experience, with strong ownership over governance, cost, safety, and operational continuity. Key responsibilities Manage building infrastructure, preventive/corrective maintenance, contracts, and service providers (cleaning, security, reception, landscaping, and specialized technical services) Coordinate corporate travel: flights, accommodations, transportation, and corporate card administration. Ensuring policy compliance, cost efficiency, and agility; Ensure availability of office supplies, pantry items, furniture, and end-to-end equipment logistics for new hires and offboardings; Provide administrative and coordination support to key leaders, including agenda management, travel, and strategic meeting logistics; Act as the main point of contact across Facilities, HR, Finance, IT, and other business areas, consolidating reports and KPIs on costs, consumption, travel, and SLAs; Lead negotiations, contracts, quality audits, and non-conformance management with specialized vendors Operate facilities and travel management platforms, turning data into decisions; What we're looking for Solid experience in facilities, office management, and/or corporate travel within multinational environments; Proven expertise in contract, vendor, and SLA management; Hands-on, organized profile, with strong cross-functional articulation and senior-stakeholder communication; Intermediate/advanced English (regular interaction with global HQ and regional operations); Previous experience with travel management platforms and facilities tools is a plus; What we offer An environment under construction, with real room for ownership, decision-making, and impact. You will join an operation that combines the pace and ambition of a fast-growing business with the strength of a global group recognized for sustainability and innovation. Location: Campinas (SP) Hybrid model until October 2026, transitioning to fully onsite afterward. Candidates must be available to work onsite in Campinas from October 2026.

title: Analista de dados
description:

Analista de Dados — Perfil e Risco Sobre a Cooperlink A Cooperlink é uma associação de proteção patrimonial mutualista que atua na proteção veicular, oferecendo aos seus associados um modelo cooperativo de rateio de prejuízos como alternativa ao seguro tradicional. Operamos com tecnologia própria, integração direta entre CRM, sistema de gestão e canais de atendimento, e uma cultura orientada a dados — onde cada decisão de produto, comercial e operacional passa pela análise de carteira, perfil de associado e exposição a risco. Nosso time de dados atua de forma transversal, com acesso direto à diretoria e impacto real nas definições estratégicas da cooperativa. Resumo da posição Profissional responsável por transformar dados de associados/segurados, apólices, sinistros e canais em análises que orientem decisões de subscrição, pricing, retenção e mitigação de risco. Atua como ponte entre as áreas técnica, comercial e operacional, traduzindo comportamento e exposição em indicadores acionáveis. Principais responsabilidades Construir e manter análises de perfil de carteira (associados, veículos, regiões, canais) identificando padrões de comportamento, consumo e propensão a sinistro. Desenvolver indicadores de risco: sinistralidade, frequência, severidade, prêmio médio, índice combinado e desvios por segmento. Apoiar a área de subscrição/underwriting com estudos de aceitação, recusa e precificação por faixa de risco. Realizar análises de churn, inadimplência e propensão à renovação, propondo ações de retenção baseadas em dados. Estruturar segmentações de carteira (clusterização por perfil de risco, ticket, vínculo, geografia). Monitorar carteira ativa: alertas de deterioração de sinistralidade, concentração de risco e desvios de meta. Construir dashboards executivos e operacionais em Power BI (ou equivalente) com camada semântica bem modelada. Criar e manter pipelines de dados em parceria com engenharia de dados, garantindo qualidade, consistência e rastreabilidade. Documentar regras de negócio, dicionário de dados e metodologias de cálculo dos indicadores de risco. Atender demandas ad hoc de diretoria, atuária, comercial e financeiro com agilidade e clareza. Requisitos obrigatórios Experiência mínima de 3 anos como Analista de Dados/BI, sendo pelo menos 1 ano no mercado segurador, de proteção patrimonial mutualista, saúde, previdência ou crédito. SQL avançado (joins complexos, CTEs, window functions, otimização de consultas). Power BI avançado: modelagem em estrela, DAX (medidas, time intelligence, variáveis), Power Query/M. Excel avançado, incluindo Power Query e estruturação de relatórios analíticos. Familiaridade com indicadores de seguro: sinistralidade, prêmio médio, frequência, severidade, índice combinado, LTV, CAC. Conhecimento de segmentação, análise de coorte e fundamentos de estatística descritiva. Boa comunicação para apresentar análises a públicos técnicos e não técnicos. Diferenciais Python (pandas, numpy, scikit-learn) ou R para análises estatísticas e modelos preditivos. Experiência com Microsoft Fabric, Databricks, Big Query ou Snowflake. Vivência em modelos de propensão (churn, sinistro, fraude) ou clusterização (K-Means, DBSCAN). Conhecimento de LGPD aplicado a dados sensíveis de clientes. Familiaridade com APIs de sistemas de gestão securitária (Hinova/SGA, Tex, Quiver, Sami) ou CRMs do setor. Noções de atuária básica e cálculo de provisões. Experiência com Git e versionamento de relatórios/scripts. Perfil comportamental Autonomia para investigar problemas de dados sem precisar de roteiro. Pensamento crítico — questiona o número antes de entregar. Postura consultiva: traduz pergunta de negócio em análise, não espera escopo pronto. Organização para lidar com múltiplas demandas simultâneas. Benefícios (Salário compatível com senioridade · VR/VA · Plano de Saúde · Total Pass · Bolsa e Auxílio Educação)

Elaborar o plano anual de comunicação e supervisionar sua condução. Supervisionar as investigações internas e auxiliar na implementação de ações corretivas. Coordenar e realizar testes de conformidade para garantir que as práticas da empresa estejam de acordo com todas as diretrizes legais e políticas internas de integridade. Avaliar a efetividade do programa de integridade e buscar melhoria contínua. Preparar relatórios e indicadores para a alta administração e órgãos reguladores externos, além de apoiar auditorias. Definir planos para gerenciar crises ou violações de conformidade. Servir como ponto de contato para autoridades regulatórias e gerir qualquer comunicação relevante. Implementar ISO 37.301. Na Minerva Foods, sustentabilidade é um compromisso que permeia nosso DNA. Adotamos práticas responsáveis que promovem a preservação ambiental, bem‑estar animal e transparência em toda a cadeia de produção. Colaborar com os times de Sales Enablement, Produto, Operações e Tecnologia para traduzir achados de QA em melhorias, aprimorando a base de conhecimento, módulos de treinamento, fluxos de trabalho e sistemas. Orientar e desenvolver Especialistas de QA, promovendo uma cultura de melhoria contínua, consistência e execução de qualidade baseada em dados. Defender melhorias operacionais, de processo e sistêmicas com uma mentalidade orientada por hipóteses e forte alinhamento com princípios mais amplos de Controle de Qualidade. Role Qualifications Mínimo de 5 a 7 anos de experiência em gestão da qualidade, auditoria de processos ou QA de vendas, especialmente em vendas de campo, tecnologia ou ambientes em escala. Capacidade comprovada de desenhar frameworks robustos de QA, incluindo scorecards, matrizes de performance, rotinas de auditoria e fluxos de escalonamento. Alta capacidade analítica: transformar dados quantitativos (CRM, métricas, dashboards) e observações qualitativas (campo, demos) em insights acionáveis. Experiência com plataformas de CRM, monitoramento de uso de sistemas e compreensão de como sistemas impactam o comportamento comercial. Perfil “mão na massa” e presença em campo: conforto para realizar visitas, avaliações presenciais e trabalhar próximo aos times operacionais. Fortes habilidades de comunicação, com assertividade para apontar lacunas operacionais e colaborar entre áreas para resolvê-las. Mentalidade de melhoria contínua, com resultados comprovados na transformação de insights de qualidade em ações práticas (treinamentos, atualizações de KB, refinamentos de processos/sistemas). From day one, you’ll take the lead on meaningful work, accelerate your growth, and gain exposure that shapes careers. Ownership That Matters:  You’ll lead high-impact projects with real business outcomes Rapid Growth:  We compress years of learning into months Merit Over Titles:  Trust and responsibility are earned through execution, not tenure Velocity with Purpose:  We move fast, support each other, and aim high — always with purpose and intention   About The Role  We’re looking for a seasoned, high-output engineer who can develop our rapidly growing agent platform for our Revenue organization. This individual will sit on our Infrastructure team that builds AI-native solutions used by the entire company to find, convert, and better enable customers with the products we launch. The ideal candidate possesses 3+ years of architecting and developing full-stack applications, proficient data analytics skills, strong interest in agentic workflows, and 5+ years working on applications or codebases built with Python, Databricks, React/JavaScript/TypeScript, and AWS. You’ll be responsible for production-grade systems that our customers and internal teams depend on daily. That means being responsive, reliable, and an excellent communicator — both when things are going well and especially when they’re not. The ideal candidate treats AI coding tools as core infrastructure for how they work — not a novelty. You’ve shipped full-stack applications, you’re comfortable navigating ambiguity, and you are customer-obsessed in your approach to improving software.  As a Senior Software Engineer, You Will  Own features and systems end-to-end across multiple product surfaces — architecture, implementation, deployment, and iteration Architect and deliver solutions for our Revenue, Revenue Operations, and Business Development teams – including data tools, applications, and agentic orchestrators Serve as a subject matter expert across the whole stack, and report directly to the Chief Architect, who will provide hands-on mentorship in cutting‑edge AI-native development, big data analytics, and cloud infrastructure. Collaborate closely with the Revenue organization, discovering opportunities, projects, and areas to revamp critical business processes with AI Drive initiatives across teams — you’re not waiting for a PM to write a spec; you’re in the room shaping what gets built and why Leverage AI tools like Claude Code, Cursor, Codex to improve personal productivity, ship trustworthy solutions faster through harness engineering, code quality, and documentation. Produce clear documentation: create playbooks, docs, and training materials to institutionalize best practices.   You Are Likely To Succeed If  You have 5+ years of hands-on software development experience with a proven track record of shipping customer-facing applications — and the impact to show for it You are stack-flexible: comfortable working across Python, TypeScript/React, and cloud infrastructure (AWS, Databricks). You learn new tools fast and don’t let unfamiliar tech slow you down You have an AI-accelerated workflow — you actively use AI coding tools  to ship faster, not as an experiment, but as how you work every day You thrive in ambiguity — you can take a vague business problem, break it down, and deliver a working solution without heavy-handed direction You are a strong communicator who can work directly with non-technical stakeholders, translate between business needs and engineering tradeoffs, and drive alignment You are responsive and reliable — you take ownership of production systems and communicate proactively, especially under pressure You have a bias toward action and ownership — you see a problem, you fix it; you see an opportunity, you ship it You hold a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, STEM, or a related technical discipline Advanced English proficiency (B2–C1 or higher)   What We Offer:  Our compensation package includes competitive salary and comprehensive benefit offerings. Opportunities to build a career as a manager or individual contributor through our career ladder that promotes based on impact. You will have regular career conversations with your manager where you will discuss your short and long-term career goals. We are committed to helping you develop in your career and offer the potential for internal mobility opportunities We care about your personal life, and we mean it. We offer flexible work hours, a remote-first work environment, flexible vacation, team events, learning reimbursement, and more! Your growth at YipitData is determined by the impact that you make, not by tenure, unnecessary facetime, or office politics. Everyone at YipitData is empowered to learn, self-improve, and master their skills in an environment focused on ownership, respect, and trust. Personal laptop Health and wellness package  Candidates must have primary residency (and be physically located) in the country of hire (AKA Brazil) in order to be considered for the position. Bonus Points For:   Certifications in more than one cloud provider FinOps Certified Practitioner or experience with cloud cost management tools. Experience with cloud provider AI/ML services. Experience conducting Well-Architected best-practice reviews. Knowledge of DevOps principles and practices. Experience in a technology consulting environment. title: Clinical Study Manager
description:
Confira a oportunidade para Clinical Study Manager em campinas. Veja requisitos e como se candidatar.

Job Summary  The Clinical Study Manager (CSM) will be part of the Clinical Operations Department, which is responsible for planning, executing, managing and closing studies associated with the company clinical development plans. The CSM is a proven leader in clinical development with study management experience in the pharmaceutical or device industry. The CSM provides leadership and support to members of the multidisciplinary program teams, internally and externally, and can successfully thrive in a virtual clinical model. The CSM reports to the Senior Director of Clinical Operations and may be based at Liquidia’s headquarters in Research Triangle Park, North Carolina, or remote. Specific Duties, Activities, and Responsibilities   Act as a patient advocate throughout the clinical development project lifecycle, with a mindset to minimize patient and site burden when participating in clinical trials. Understand and support trial milestones including site identification and assessment, patient/subject recruitment, Key Opinion Leader (KOL) and Steering Committee development, and medical affairs support as required. Coordinate internally with Medical and Quality Assurance to identify risks to clinical trial projects. Participates in the development of study timelines, in coordination with the internal study team and external partners. Manages the trial according to agreed timelines. Develop Requests for Proposals for vendors (CRO, Bioanalytical Labs, Central Safety Labs, Data Management groups, etc.) required to support clinical studies. Assist or lead the vetting of vendors and sites for study participation. In collaboration with Program Leaders, lead the development and updates of study specific protocols, consent forms, and other trial related materials (e.g., Study Monitoring Plan, Data Management Plans, CRFs, site training materials, Advertising Materials, etc.) as required. Oversee the work of CROs and other vendors (Central Labs, Clinical Supply Distributors, etc.) as assigned to clinical trials. Identifies potential risks to timelines, budgets, and quality, and participates in establishing and overseeing mitigation strategies with the internal team members and external partners, as applicable. Manage and track clinical trial budgets to include forecasting, review, and approval of vendor and site payments. The CSM is also responsible for notifying management of anticipated change orders and/or budget adjustments proactively Assumes primary accountability for assigned clinical trial execution according to protocol requirements, trial plans, company SOPs, ICH-GCP, FDA regulations, and applicable regulations in other regions. Collaboratively work with the project team and other CRO/vendor resources and timelines associated with all study activities, including CRO/investigator agreements, central IRBs, database development and maintenance, monitoring strategy, QA audit plan, and coordination of Clinical Safety Review Teams when applicable. Supports material planning and management to ensure appropriate execution of the clinical projects, including but not limited to distribution of documents, forms, supplies, equipment, and investigational product. Reviews reports from study data systems which show progress of data collection, source document verification, and query resolution. Reports untimely data entry to Program lead. Collaborates with Program Lead and medical monitor to ensure adverse event review and coding review occur on the timelines detailed in study plans. Assists with review of study data reports during the cleaning phase of a study (i.e. prior to interim analysis or database lock) and aligns with team on any issues needing escalation. Ensure the Trial Master File (TMF) is maintained and up to date and all documents are accounted for by completion of clinical study report. Generate compelling periodic trial Newsletters to communicate important trial aspects to trial sites.  Ensure the development and maintenance of trial-specific tracking systems to enable proper study management and monitoring activities, as required Work with the Senior Director of Clinical Operations, or similar to ensure that internal program team members are trained appropriately on study conduct Serve as a liaison between external partners and internal team to ensure program specific information and ongoing updates are proactively communicated Participates in the development, review, and implementation of departmental SOPs, processes, and initiatives. Attend off-site meetings and conferences, as needed. Mentorship of junior colleagues in Clinical Operations and other departments in areas of oversight to foster development and expansion of junior colleague skill sets.  Education and Experience  Bachelors with a minimum of five years of experience in clinical research, with at least two years of clinical project/study management.  Experience qualifying & managing external vendors (e.g. CRO, Call Center, Central labs, etc.). Experience managing clinical project team personnel. Experience leading operational teams through the start-up, study conduct, data management, and report writing of clinical studies. Experience liaising cross-functional teams internally and with external partners to align on program expectations. Experience reviewing and editing protocols and clinical study reports. Demonstrates knowledge of Good Clinical Practices and all applicable US regulations governing clinical research, as well as working knowledge of the FDA submission process. Experience in Global clinical studies and country/region specific regulations governing clinical research outside of the US. Excellent organization and communication skills, including experience dealing with decision makers such as physicians and IRB members. Demonstrates problem-solving and interpersonal skills.Must have a ‘can-do’ attitude and a strong desire to take ownership of many different projects. Ability to work independently and manage multiple timelines, while maintaining the team focus. Demonstrated ability to exercise judgment and determine appropriate action to a variety of problems of varying complexity. Demonstrated ability to manage multiple deadlines.  Knowledge, Skills and Abilities  Strong desire to join a small company and work in a fast-paced environment. Ability to work with remote teams and to negotiate with external providers. Must be detail oriented, highly organized, reliable, and accurate. Must be a motivated self-starter, adaptable, and capable of working within a matrix environment. Must display sound judgment and discretion as well as problem solving abilities especially within a team environment. Experience with tools and systems for managing clinical rials (CTMS, TMF, EDC, ePRO database, Microsoft suite, etc.). . Compelling interpersonal verbal, written and presentation skills in communication with internal and external customers. Must have the ability to accommodate international and domestic travel up to 30% at the request of the business. Must be fluent in English

This isn’t just another engineering role. We’re solving real, painful inefficiencies in the insurance space –  problems so frustrating that prospects have nearly teared up during sales calls, realizing how much time and effort we could save them. What we’re building isn’t just an upgrade – it’s a fundamental shift in how agencies operate . What You’ll Do:  Architect and develop scalable TypeScript microservices powering XILO’s platform. You’ll have the opportunity to work where your strengths shine  and contribute to: AI Agents  – Automating complex decision-making and workflows OCR & Document Processing  – Extracting, structuring, and analyzing key insights from insurance documents  Intelligent Data Mapping  – Aggregating and linking all relevant data into a centralized, dynamic user profile  Advanced Insurance Operations & CRM  – The AI-powered backbone  of agencies, seamlessly tracking, managing, and integrating customer data across tools and workflows  while replacing outdated, manual processes Forms Builder & Smart Data Entry  – A Typeform-like system  built for insurance, enabling error-proof, collaborative submissions – fill once, apply everywhere  Optimize system performance, reliability, and scalability. What we’re looking for  7+ years of backend development experience, with a strong foundation in TypeScript and JavaScript. Strong experience with Node.js Proven expertise in designing and developing software product features, with a focus on scalability, performance, and maintainability. Proven expertise in REST API design – including authentication, performance optimization, and security best practices. Experience with XML and SOAP-based integrations, commonly used in the insurance industry. Strong hands-on experience with Nest.js, leveraging its modular architecture for scalable backend services. Familiarity with NX monorepos for structuring and maintaining large-scale applications. Cloud deployment experience on Heroku and AWS, including CI/CD pipelines and infrastructure management. Deep understanding of database management, ORM usage (e.g., TypeORM, Prisma, Sequelize), and zero-downtime migration strategies. Experience designing and implementing microservices architectures, including inter-service communication, data consistency, and service decoupling. Bonus: Full-stack experience with modern frontend frameworks like Angular. Advanced English proficiency (B2–C1 or higher).  What we offer  Collaborative and innovative work environment Flex PTO for any reason, including sick days (no specified limits), flexible work schedule. Personal laptop. Health and wellness package. Budget for English lessons.  Why Join XILO?  A great tech startup  – Small, fast-moving, and driven by real impact Endless career growth  – Help shape the team, tech, and company as we scale Strong leadership & backing  – Work alongside experienced founders and tier 1 silicon-valley VCs  Kindly submit your application and CV in English.

You will act as an internal consultant outlining high-level technical strategies, while also personally executing the hands-on development—including software integrations, AI adoption, and workflow automations. Translate non-technical business requirements into actionable architectural designs and technical scopes. Act as an internal consultant, proposing ROI-driven technology implementations. Automation, Integration & AI Implementation  Design, build, and maintain system integrations across our SaaS ecosystem utilizing REST APIs, webhooks, and middleware platforms (e.g., Zapier, Make, n8n) or custom scripts (Python, JavaScript). Evaluate, test, and deploy AI tools to automate routine operational tasks. Administer databases and ensure data integrity as information flows between the CRM, ERP, and operational software.  IT Administration & Security  Administer core software platforms and directories, including (Google Workspace / Microsoft 365). Manage the employee technology lifecycle, including hardware provisioning and onboarding/offboarding technical access. Enforce cybersecurity best practices, managing Identity and Access Management (IAM), SSO, MFA, and endpoint security. Manage IT vendor relationships, negotiate SaaS contracts, and monitor software spend to systematically prevent tool sprawl.  Required Qualifications & Skills  Technical Experience:  5+ years of hybrid experience spanning IT Administration, Systems Architecture, Technical Operations, Business Process Engineering, or Software Integration. Demonstrated experience managing technology projects end-to-end within an SMB or startup environment. Strong understanding of cloud-based SaaS ecosystems, APIs, and relational data structures. High proficiency in building complex workflows using middleware (e.g., n8n, Make, Zapier) or lightweight scripting. Practical knowledge of applying AI tools to everyday business workflows. Foundational understanding of cybersecurity risk management, network security, and data privacy protocols.  Soft Skills & Behavioral Competencies:  Communication:  Proven ability to effectively translate business needs into technical scopes, and explain complex technical concepts and security requirements to non-technical stakeholders with patience and clarity. Critical Thinking:  Strong analytical approach to problem-solving; ability to identify the root causes of operational friction rather than just treating symptoms. Decision-Making:  Highly autonomous execution; capable of evaluating vendor tools, technical trade-offs, and ROI to make definitive architectural and software purchasing decisions.  Benefits & Compensation  Compensation details will be discussed during the interview process.

title: Technical Product Owner
description:
Empresa está contratando Technical Product Owner em campinas. Veja detalhes e envie seu currículo.

ABOUT US  Syniti , part of Capgemini, tackles the hardest work in data for the world’s largest organizations. We combine intelligent software with deep data expertise to help the Fortune2000 tackle complex data challenges and drive measurable business outcomes with business-ready data. Syniti’s Data First strategy transforms data from an afterthought into a strategic asset—unlocking insights, reducing risk, and fueling growth. With over 5,000 successful projects, we support the full data lifecycle through a unified platform for migration, quality, replication, matching, master data management, analytics, governance, and strategy. Operating globally across industries, Syniti’s award-winning software, expert consultants give enterprises a unique edge in managing and maximizing their data. Syniti’s cloud-native platform sets new standards in enterprise data management, combining powerful SaaS solutions with deep domain expertise. Designed for agility and scale, our technology helps customers accelerate digital transformation, drive innovation, and make confident decisions with trusted data. Every product enhancement is built to solve real business challenges—empowering organizations to unlock value from their data faster and more effectively. THE ROLE  We are seeking a highly technical and execution‑driven Technical Product Owner  to serve as the “engine room” of our platform. In this role, you will translate high‑level product strategy into clear, actionable, and technically sound work for engineering teams. You will bridge complex legacy ERP architectures (SAP S/4HANA, ECC) with modern, cloud‑native, AI‑driven workflows across the Syniti Knowledge Platform. This role goes far beyond writing tickets — we are looking for someone who uses AI for deep research, builds mockup screens to define user journeys, and ensures the creation of the “Golden Record” through seamless end‑to‑end integration across cataloging, migration, quality, and governance. What You’ll Do  Product Ownership & Agile Execution: Lead 2–3 scrum teams by owning and prioritizing the backlog for key SKP capabilities (Migrate, Replicate, Drive, Orchestrate). Run high-impact backlog grooming, sprint planning, and estimation sessions. Modern Requirement Engineering: Translate strategy into crisp Epics and User Stories. Use AI-driven tools to accelerate documentation, explore ERP integration patterns, and generate edge-case test scenarios. UX & Workflow Prototyping: Design mockups and wireframes (Figma, v0, Miro) to visualize data journeys. Ensure that both Data Stewards and Developers experience intuitive, world‑class workflows within SKP. Lifecycle Integration: Partner with Architecture and Engineering to define functional and non‑functional requirements (scalability, security). Ensure seamless integration across the entire data lifecycle to eliminate duplication and unlock full platform value. Quality & Acceptance: Collaborate with the PXQ team to define “What Good Looks Like.” Act as the final validation gate to ensure features meet enterprise standards and align with real‑world user behavior. Operational Feedback Loop: Engage with Support and Customer Success to funnel production learnings into the backlog, ensuring continuous improvement based on real customer usage.  WHAT IT TAKES  The Technical Veteran: 5+ years as a Product Owner or Business Analyst working on enterprise data products. Strong understanding of data integration, replication, APIs, and cloud-native architectures (AWS/Azure). The ERP Expert: Deep experience with SAP ecosystems and large-scale transformation programs. Understanding of MDM, Data Quality, and Governance “plumbing.” Experience with SAP MDG or Informatica is a major plus. The Modern Builder: An AI-native thinker who uses LLMs to enhance productivity and research. Prefers mockups over long documents and thrives in visual communication. The Agile Leader: CSPO-certified with demonstrated ability to manage risks, dependencies, and scope changes across distributed, multi-time‑zone teams. The Academic: Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or related practical experience. The Communicator: Able to clearly articulate complex data and replication logic to business users while also explaining product vision to engineering teams.  Key Skills  Visionary Leadership:  Ability to maintain a clear product vision, define objectives, and mentor teams toward business goals. Advanced Governance Concepts:  Strong command of data management and governance principles, including hierarchy and survivorship rules. AI/ML Application:  Experience using AI/ML tools for documentation automation, market trend analysis, and optimization of data‑matching or data‑cleansing logic. Visual Communication:  Skilled at producing wireframes and process flows to ensure UX alignment. Technical Storyboarding:  Ability to write precise user stories and acceptance criteria with zero ambiguity. Relationship Orchestration:  Strong interpersonal skills to influence stakeholders and drive collaborative engagement. Drive for Results:  Relentless focus on delivering incremental value and ensuring release readiness in a fast‑moving environment.  Be fully aligned with our core values: Think Big  - Be courageous and bold. Aspire to greatness. Relentlessly pursue market innovation. Set the standard by which others follow. Create solutions that have a meaningful impact. Solve the challenges our customers don’t know they have. Be Curious  - Be a lifelong learner. Seek out new ideas to serve customers. Understand our competition and the world. Be permanently dissatisfied with the status quo. Challenge preconceptions. Focus on the future rather than yesterday. Take Action  - Be the first. Don’t wait. Take accountability. Inspire others by doing. Fail fast and learn from mistakes. Make a difference every day. Stronger Together  - Respect, trust and look out for each other. Celebrate diverse perspectives. Listen. Build connections and belonging. Act with integrity. Give back. One Syniti family. By applying for this position, you acknowledge and consent to your image being captured (video or screenshot) for employment purposes, including during the hiring and onboarding process.  WHAT WE OFFER  Trust that you are proficient at what you do. At Syniti, you will find a supportive environment and access to learning tools, but micromanagement is not our thing. Growth. We are growing rapidly and steadily solving the biggest challenges enterprise companies are faced with today. There was never a better time to join and grow with us. Most importantly, you will have the chance to shape our journey and share in our success story. Support. We all rely on each other and enable each other to be successful. You won’t stand alone. Curiosity and genuine interest in you. We all have our different stories, all equally fascinating, with each depicting a different journey, and we want to hear them all. Recognition. We are the sum of individual achievements, and we always take the time to celebrate them. An open organisation. Hierarchies are not our thing, and access is something we make sure of across the board. We are a family where everyone is just as important, everyone’s work is seen, and ideas are valued.  OUR COMMITMENT TO INCLUSION At Syniti, we’re committed to creating a respectful, inclusive, and fair workplace where everyone belongs and thrives. We believe that diverse perspectives make us stronger — and we value the unique backgrounds, experiences, and voices each person brings to our team. We welcome applicants based on their skills and potential, and we’re dedicated to ensuring equal opportunities for all, regardless of personal background. If you need accommodations during the hiring process, please let us know — we’re here to support you.

title: Data Scientist - Sênior (Motor de Busca)
description:
Confira a oportunidade para Data Scientist - Sênior (Motor de Busca) em campinas. Veja requisitos e como se candidatar.

No Grupo SBF, reunimos duas grandes forças do esporte no Brasil: a Centauro, maior varejista esportiva multimarcas da América Latina, e a Fisia, distribuidora oficial da Nike no país. Queremos ser referência em esporte no Brasil e construir um futuro em que cada experiência com o esporte inspire, motive e transforme. E aí, que tal vestir essa camisa com a gente? Buscamos uma pessoa Cientista de Dados para atuar na squad de Busca, com foco em Busca Semântica, relevância e ranking. Essa posição tem papel estratégico na evolução da experiência de busca, atuando desde a definição de hipóteses até a implementação, experimentação e mensuração de impacto, com forte interface com Produto, Engenharia e Negócio. Responsabilidades:  Desenvolver e evoluir soluções de Busca Semântica utilizando Elasticsearch, indo além da busca lexical tradicional. Atuar na definição e otimização de: Estrutura de índices e mappings Estratégias de ranking híbrido (lexical + semântico) Queries semânticas (ex: embeddings, similarity search, boosting contextual) Trabalhar com vetorização de conteúdo (produtos, termos de busca, atributos) para melhoria de relevância. Avaliar e evoluir métricas de qualidade de busca. Conduzir testes A/B e experimentos controlados para validar impacto das melhorias semânticas. Traduzir problemas de negócio e experiência do usuário em soluções analíticas e modelos de dados. Atuar em parceria com Engenharia e Produto na definição do roadmap técnico de busca. Garantir boas práticas de ciência de dados: versionamento, documentação, reprodutibilidade e monitoramento. Apoiar tecnicamente outros cientistas de dados do time, elevando o nível das discussões técnicas.  Requisitos necessários  Formação superior completa em Ciência da Computação, Estatística, Matemática ou áreas afins. Experiência comprovada de 5 a 7 anos em projetos de ciência de dados. Experiência prática com Busca Semântica em Elasticsearch Experiência com Information Retrieval (IR) e conceitos de relevância. Conhecimento em NLP aplicado à busca (ex: embeddings, similaridade textual). Experiência com modelos de ranking ou learning to rank. Domínio de SQL para análise de grandes volumes de dados. Proficiência em Python para análise de dados, experimentação e modelagem. Vivência com experimentação e testes A/B em ambientes de produto. Capacidade de comunicação clara com públicos técnicos e não técnicos. Experiência em produtos digitais com alto volume de dados. Noções de MLOps. Sólida vivência em versionamento de código (Git), com prática de code review, padrões de branches e integração contínua.  Diferenciais  Vivência com BigQuery ou data lakes. Experiência prévia em e-commerce, marketplace ou plataformas de discovery. Experiência em observabilidade e monitoramento da qualidade da busca. Conhecimento em técnicas de visualização de dados e storytelling. Familiaridade com ferramentas de business intelligence, como Power BI.  Perfil esperado   Forte mentalidade de produto e experiência do usuário. Perfil analítico, curioso e orientado a impacto. Autonomia para conduzir iniciativas complexas de ponta a ponta. Capacidade de influenciar decisões técnicas e de produto com dados. Boa colaboração em times multidisciplinares.  #SeleçãoSBF #VempraSBF
